species: evaluate the function of protein domains during hepatocyte specification from human pluripotent stem cells.
tissue: To study the effect of editing HNF4α in liver cells, we differentiated WT, DBD Mut, and SUMO Mut clones towards hepatic lineage using a stage-wise differentiation protocol.
cell_type: we examined alterations in the proteome at differentiation day 9 from WT, DBD Mut, and SUMO Mut lines.
disease_state: Following genome editing, one WT, one homozygous deletion mutant (DBD Mut), and one point mutated clone (SUMO Mut) were expanded, differentiated, and characterized in detail.
sample_source: WT human embryonic stem cells transited through definitive endoderm stage (differentiation day 3)
cell_line: we examined alterations in the proteome at differentiation day 9 from WT, DBD Mut, and SUMO Mut lines.
